title: (Senior) Project Manager (all genders)
description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. 
Du hast weitreichende Projekterfahrung in unterschiedlichen Kontexten gesammelt und große Projekte erfolgreich geleitet? Dann suchen wir Dich als (Senior) Project Manager (all genders), um mit uns gemeinsam digitale Lösungen für die eSociety zu realisieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst große IT-Projekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – agil, klassisch oder hybrid
  • Mit deinem interdisziplinären Team übersetzt Du Kundenanforderungen in neue und bestehende IT-Lösungen und –Prozesse, in Agilen Projekt-Setups agierst du dabei als Product Owner
  • Du setzt Projekte in einem vielfältigen technologischen Umfeld um – von Content und Formular Management Systemen (CMS, FMS) über Lowcode-Plattformen, Entwicklung individueller Fachanwendungen bis hin zu Workplace-Lösungen
  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit zu Fragen der digitalen Transformation und berätst zu Lösungen aus dem ]init[-Portfolio
  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und das Schnittstellenmanagement zwischen verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern
  • Du bringst deine Stärken in der Gestaltung & Moderation von Workshops mit Kunden ein und entwickelst Strategien zur effizienten Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen
  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in der Zusammenarbeit nach intern und extern, erarbeitest zielgerichtete Handlungsempfehlungen und gestaltest Veränderungsprozesse proaktiv


Das bringst du mit

  • Websites, Intranets, Apps, digitale Antragssysteme oder Fachanwendungen: Du begeisterst dich für die Umsetzung von herausragenden IT-Projekten
  • Du hast 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von IT-Projekten gesammelt und kannst eigenständig Projekte leiten
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen oder klassischen Projektmethoden und rundest mit einer Zertifizierung idealerweise dein Profil ab (z.B. PMI/CAPM, Prince2, Scrum PSPO/PSM)
  • Du hast Freude an komplexen technischen Fragestellungen, am Austausch mit Kunden und bringst ein Gespür für deren Bedürfnisse mit und hast sich daraus ergebende Vertriebspotentiale immer im Blick
  • Mit Deinem Kommunikationsgeschick bewegst Du Dich souverän auf allen Ebenen der Projektorganisation, vermittelst komplexe Themen klar und adressatengerecht
  • Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.


Your Mission

  • End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.
  • Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.
  • Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.
  • Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments.
  • Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset
  • Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. 
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures.
  • Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants.
  • Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing.
  • Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build.
  • Proactive mindset with strong autonomy and initiative in a dynamic environment 
  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus.


Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes
    • Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities
    • Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.
  • Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment
    • State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.
  • Company pension program (bAV)
    • Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution—investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership
    • Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
  • Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage
    • We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.
  • Free bike options
    • Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.
  • Complimentary food & beverages
    • Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.
  • Personalized workspace setup
    • €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one.
  • Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program)
    • You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.
Sounds like a perfect fit? We can’t wait to meet you – apply now and be part of our journey!

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren.
Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie.


Du als Teil von tonies:

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben.
Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten.
Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen.


Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

IT-Strategie & Architektur

  • Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit.
  • Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce).
  • Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX.
IT-Governance & Sicherheit
  • Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal).
  • Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.).
  • Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans.
  • Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende.
  • Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen.


Was wir uns von dir wünschen:

  • Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich).
  • Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards.
  • Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“.
  • Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365).
  • Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen.
  • Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten.
  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus).


Warum tonies?

Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt. 

Wir freuen uns auf deine digitale Bewerbung!

tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold.   • Prior Experience a Plus: Internships or working student experience in licensing, marketing, or business development are a plus but not required.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Good communication and presentation skills in both German and English, confident when interacting with external partners.
  • Personality: A proactive, structured, and eager-to-learn personality who enjoys working independently and thrives in an international, dynamic environment.


Why tonies?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world. 
  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best. 
  • Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm.
  • Holiday package: Enjoy 20 days of annual leave (based on a 5-day week) plus additional days off on Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, and "Rosenmontag" (Carnival). 
  • tonies discount: Shop with discounts in our tonies online shop. 
  • Corporate Benefits: Access further employee discounts through our Corporate Benefits portal.


Good to know:

At tonies®, inclusion and diversity are part of our core principles. We celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, beliefs, and gender identities that come together under our roof. Every face is welcome, and we support everyone through all stages of their development with us. 

We look forward to receiving your application!

description:

Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH is an innovative, fast-growing company in the field of sustainable lithium extraction and renewable energies. Your mission

Construction & Procurement Contracts

  • You draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of project agreements, including EPCM, EPC, D&C, framework, consultancy, and other commercial contracts.

Project Development
  • You provide practical, business-oriented legal support across the full project lifecycle, from origination and development through construction and operations.

Operations
  • You collaborate with the Supply Chain team to develop and implement contracting strategies that support operational activities.
  • You draft, review, and negotiate maintenance, service, works, hire, and other operational agreements.
  • You provide practical legal guidance on operational contract management and ongoing commercial relationships.
  • You support business stakeholders in managing contractual risks throughout the operational phase.
 
Claims Management
  • You lead the legal management of claims arising from construction, procurement, and commercial contracts.
  • You assess contractual entitlements, liabilities, and potential exposure while developing effective claims strategies with cross-functional teams.
  • You prepare and review notices, claims submissions, responses, and supporting documentation to protect the company's interests.
  • You coordinate external legal counsel and technical experts in litigation, arbitration, adjudication, and settlement negotiations.


Your profile

  • You have 5-10 years of post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or within a multinational in-house legal team and have achieved at least satisfactory results in both German State Examinations.

  • You have knowledge of project delivery and construction frameworks, including VOB/B, FIDIC, permitting processes, regulatory requirements, and public law matters.
  • You have experience managing contractual claims, disputes, and risk-related matters throughout the project lifecycle.
  • You work effectively with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and business functions.
  • You demonstrate strong commercial judgment, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to engage with senior leadership and project executives.
  • You are highly organized, resilient, and adaptable, act with integrity and discretion, communicate effectively, and are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Senior Finance Manager to join our London team. In this role, you’ll lead key aspects of the reporting and accounting process, ensuring our financial operations remain robust and scalable.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Europe Accounting team. This team acts as the engine room for our financial integrity, bridging the gap between local operations and global reporting standards during an exciting period of integration.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Reporting Excellence: Lead month-end and quarter-end close activities, ensuring all financial reporting deliverables are accurate, timely, and aligned with US headquarters requirements.

  • Operational Oversight: Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis to maintain the highest standards of financial accuracy.

  • Process Transformation: Identify process gaps and implement scalable controls to strengthen financial governance and shorten close cycles across Europe.

  • Strategic Partnering: Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in Operations and regional teams to streamline accounting workflows and improve data quality.

  • Audit & Compliance: Coordinate internal and external audit requests while maintaining comprehensive documentation for key accounting processes and SOPs.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Professional Qualification: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent accountancy qualification with at least 4 years of post-qualified experience.

  • Technical Depth: Significant post-qualification experience within a complex, fast-paced financial environment, ideally with a focus on group reporting.

  • System Proficiency: Strong understanding of NetSuite (or equivalent ERP systems) and financial reporting tools.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to partner with cross-functional teams and influence senior leaders across different regions and functions.

  • Adaptability: A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive outcomes in an evolving global business environment.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days)

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

Head of Product - B2B
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋

Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly.

This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them.

In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets.

  • Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention.

  • Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio.

  • Establish AI-native ways of working across the team - embedding modern tooling, setting standards for how AI accelerates discovery, delivery, and decision-making, and ensuring the team operates at the leading edge of product practice.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Commercial Finance to deliver scalable, reliable distribution products that meet the needs of TMCs, OBTs, and other partners.

  • Represent Product in commercial and partner discussions, acting as a credible voice on capability, roadmap, and strategic direction with senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Drive a culture of clear prioritisation, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement - ensuring the team is always working on what matters most.

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior product leadership role, with ownership of strategy, delivery, and commercial outcomes for partner-facing products.

  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, with the ability to set high standards and build team capability over time.

  • Commercial acumen and confidence working closely with Sales and Account Management organisations, with a clear understanding of how product decisions connect to revenue and retention.

  • Experience owning or contributing to a P&L, with the ability to translate financial performance into clear product priorities.

  • A hands-on approach to AI - you use it in your own work and understand how to embed it meaningfully into team workflows and product processes, ideally with experience setting AI-native standards across a product organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and UX at a senior level.

  • Ideally, experience working with distribution platforms, APIs, or partner-facing technology in a travel, transport, or similarly complex B2B environment.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures. You will play a key part in shaping the architecture in a genuinely exciting and fast-paced domain.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

  • Hands-on experience with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system.

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems fundamentals, even without core execution-engine experience specifically.

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or general lakehouse/data-lake architectures.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

title: Senior Business Travel Consultant - Perk UKI (English speaker)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are seeking outstanding Executive / VIP Business Travel Consultants to deliver an elite, seven-star service experience to senior leaders, executives, and high-value corporate clients. This role is designed for someone who understands that Executive Travel is not transactional it is highly personalised, time-critical, and relationship-driven.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in hospitality, premium travel, or luxury customer service, paired with a solid understanding of contact centre operations where productivity, efficiency, and CSAT must coexist. You will be comfortable operating at pace, managing complex itineraries, and making confident decisions on behalf of discerning clients.

You will have strong GDS experience though we are able to provide full cross platform training for candidates who have experience in Amadeus, Sabre or another GDS.

This role is offered either as:

Hub based on hybrid 3 days IRL - permanent contract
OR

Fully remote - if working as a 2-year fixed-term contract

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivering a seamless, proactive, and anticipatory experience for Executive and VIP travellers

  • Acting as a trusted advisor, not just a booking agent

  • Managing highly complex, often last-minute travel changes with calm professionalism

  • Consistently achieving strong CSAT while meeting productivity and efficiency expectations

  • Demonstrating excellent ownership, judgement, and accountability in every interaction

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-end management of Executive and VIP corporate travel, including air, hotel, ground transport, and bespoke requests

  • Providing expert recommendations aligned to traveller preferences, company policy, and duty of care

  • Handling urgent and high-impact travel disruptions with speed, empathy, and precision

  • Managing multiple channels (phone, chat, email) in a fast-paced Executive Care environment

  • Balancing premium service delivery with operational KPIs such as productivity, handle time, and SLA adherence

  • Building long-term relationships with Executive travellers through consistent, high-quality service

  • Collaborating closely with peers to maintain a high-performance, elite service culture

What We’re Looking For

Essential:

  • Proven experience delivering high-touch, premium customer service (Executive travel, hospitality, aviation, luxury brands, or similar)

  • GDS experience (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo or similar)

  • Strong understanding of contact centre performance metrics, including productivity, efficiency, and CSAT

  • Exceptional communication skills with a polished, confident, and discreet style

  • Ability to remain calm, decisive, and solutions-focused in high-pressure situations

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

Desirable:

  • Experience supporting senior stakeholders, C-suite, or high-net-worth individuals

  • Exposure to out-of-hours, follow-the-sun, or on-call travel support models

Personal Attributes

  • Naturally service-oriented with a strong hospitality mindset

  • High emotional intelligence and sound judgement

  • Comfortable working autonomously and taking full ownership

  • Resilient, adaptable, and confident handling ambiguity

  • Commercially aware and performance-driven without compromising service quality

To note - the work schedule for this role is currently between 8am-8pm Monday-Friday with a rotational weekend shift.

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 90 min Virtual or IRL depending on your location
Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

  • Own key financial controls, monthly close, management reporting, and audit coordination.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche. 

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.


Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.

  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich) 

  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.

  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).

  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.

  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel. 

  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.


Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.

  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.

  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

title: Junior business data scientist - Marketing & commercial effectiveness
description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne.  

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation.  

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

 
📊Et si nous vous présentions quelques datas ?
 
• 400 expert.e.s en data science  
• 1000 projets divers et variés pour plus de 350 clients  
• 5 bureaux : Paris, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Londres et New York  
• +1 milliards de $ de gains générés pour nos clients chaque année
• 7000 tonnes de CO2 évitées pour nos clients en 2022
  
🌱Chez Ekimetrics nous avons l’ambition d’accompagner nos clients à repenser leur business model, en réconciliant performance économique et objectifs durables, grâce à la data science.
 
C’est pourquoi nous avons en interne toutes les compétences nous permettant de répondre aux besoins de nos clients : Product Managers, Product Designers, Data Architects, Lead Tech, Data Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Data Scientists.
 
Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?
 
Notre positionnement unique sur le marché vous permettra d’allier des compétences techniques telles que l’économétrie, l’économie, les statistiques et les mathématiques appliquées avec de la programmation. Il vous permettra également de développer des compétences en stratégie, conseil et marketing afin de répondre au mieux aux problématiques business de nos clients.
 
Votre rôle dans l’équipe :
 
Votre rôle dans l’équipe : 
  • Manipuler des bases de données, cleaning, avec l’utilisation d’outils adaptés  comme Python et/ou Excel. 
  • Analyser des données et réaliser des modèles  d'économétrie, statistiques bayésienne etc.
  • Analyser et construire la stratégie marketing et optimisation media en s’appuyant sur les modèles.
  • Participer également à la construction des livrables et à la présentation des recommandations à nos clients
Profil recherché : 
  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur généraliste ou d’une école de commerce.
  • Vous avez de bonnes bases en programmation, ainsi qu'une expérience en Python et avec les modèles de data science.
  • Vous savez analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations stratégiques pour répondre aux enjeux business.
  • Votre curiosité, votre esprit analytique et votre aisance en communication vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec différentes parties prenantes.
  •  Une expérience académique ou professionnelle sur Databricks/Azure est un plus.
 
🤝 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Rejoindre Ekimetrics, c’est intégrer une entreprise dont les valeurs s’appliquent au quotidien :
 
• Evoluer dans un environnement type start-up et non traditionnel (#curiosité)
• Être capable de prendre le feedback pour s’améliorer (#excellence)
• Se former dès son arrivée et en continu grâce à une expérience apprenante unique et riche de nombreuses ressources (internes, externes, live et digital) alliant savoirs techniques, savoir-être et savoir-faire (#transmission)
• Faire partie d’une communauté accueillante et soudée (#plaisir)
• Imaginer des solutions inattendues & sortir de sa zone de confort (#créativité)
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work.

title: Content & Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About Dedale:

Dedale is the differentiating source of strategic intelligence in the technology space.

With a unique team of over 100 full-time research analysts & planners, Dedale leverages a network of over 10,000 market professionals to deliver on-the-ground strategic intelligence to investors and corporates, with a core focus around North America and Europe.

Our team gathers top talents with diverse and international backgrounds. Our Research & Investment team has the strongest expertise in the ecosystem on B2B Software due diligence, and we are surrounded by a network of mentors including high-profile tech founders and investors.

 

Our Culture:

Dedale gathers a group of highly talented international individuals (incl. US, Chinese, Filipino, French, Moroccan, Latvian, Lebanese nationalities among others).

The leadership team is composed of experienced investment professionals & management consultants (ex-McKinsey, BCG Project Leaders & managers).

Our advisory board is extremely high profile, including some of the most successful investors worldwide (incl. Managing Partners of the largest PE and Growth Equity funds, and Tech unicorn entrepreneurs).

We seek to develop a dream team of outstanding investment analysts with strong academic and professional achievements and a passion for investing and technology.

Your Opportunity

As a Content & Lead Generation Specialist, you will own the content-to-pipeline engine at Dedale. You will design, produce, distribute, and optimize all content that turns Dedale's intelligence into qualified leads — across our platform, LinkedIn, newsletters, gated reports, email sequences, and search. This is a builder role, not an executor role. You won't wait for briefs to write themselves: you will propose, test, iterate, and report. You will own your streams end-to-end, from editorial decisions to performance data, driving content that converts.

Your Responsibilities

1. Lead Generation Engine & Social Media

  • Manage the production calendar and pipeline for gated reports (2/month) and lead capture mechanics

  • Drive Dedale's LinkedIn presence (12 posts/month), writing, scheduling, and optimizing for engagement/CTR across company and leadership accounts

  • Write, segment, and monitor the monthly newsletter sent to our leads list

  • Design email sequences and community nurturing flows (segment logic, copy, deliverability) to build active, autonomous segments (PE, Corporate, Members)

  • Execute and monitor LinkedIn Ad campaigns based on strategy briefs

2. Editorial & Platform Content Ownership

  • Fully own the Tech Leaders interview series: outreach, production, platform publishing, and community follow-up, while experimenting with new formats and distribution tests

  • Build and manage the Super Experts stream: routing, editing, and publishing expert profiles

  • Support new strategic streams, including Talent Intelligence, Ask Dedale launch content, and dedicated US storytelling

  • Maintain employer branding initiatives and propose new ways to surface team culture

3. SEO, GEO & Website Optimization

  • Take full ownership of organic search performance, executing a strategic SEO/GEO audit and implementing a cluster content framework

  • Optimize on-page content, structured data, entity definitions, and visibility in AI-generated answers (GEO) to drive organic sessions

  • Drive lead capture optimization on the website, improving CTA placement, landing pages, and gated demo executions in Webflow

4. Event Support & Intelligence Capitalization

  • Manage pre-event briefs and post-event debriefs with Topic Leaders across key cluster events

  • Format and publish debrief outputs as intelligence pages on the platform

Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Contexte :

Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré (article de perspective – projet Best-Crop). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites).

Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud.

Objectifs :

Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire.

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description:
Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA).

DESCRIPTIF

Contexte scientifique :

Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé.

Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique.

Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre.

Verrous scientifiques :

La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effet de la tension de surface.

La qualité finale des poudres dépend de quatre paramètres opératoires principaux : la puissance du procédé, le débit de poudre, les débits de gaz (central, gaine, porteur), et la position axiale de la sonde d'injection de poudre dans le plasma. Sur la torche TekSphero40 (20-40 kW) et pour l'AlSi10Mg, trois verrous scientifiques sont identifiés et doivent être levés simultanément :

• Verrou 1 :

Coalescence des particules : les gouttelettes fondues, en raison de leur faible viscosité, fusionnent lors de collisions en vol, provoquant un grossissement non contrôlé de la distribution granulométrique. Ceci a été particulièrement observé dans nos essais sur la sphéroïdisation de AlSi10Mg. Dans la littérature, cet effet a été rapporté sur une poudre de tungstène (Zhu et al. 2017).

• Verrou 2 :

Évaporation des éléments légers : le magnésium (Tvap = 1091 °C) s'évapore préférentiellement dans le plasma, provoquant un appauvrissement en Mg de l'alliage (perte de la phase durcissante Mg₂Si) et la formation de fumées métalliques.

• Verrou 3 :

Formation de nanoparticules : les vapeurs métalliques produite dans le plasma conduisent à la condensation en nanoparticules polluantes et parfois, de dépôts satellites sur les grosses particules.

Ces trois verrous sont couplés : augmenter la puissance ou le temps de séjour améliore la sphéricité mais aggrave la coalescence et l'évaporation. Le problème est intrinsèquement multi-objectifs et aucune solution "toute faite" n'existe dans la littérature pour cet alliage.

MISSION ET ACTIVITES

Le post-doc développera un modèle permettant de prédire le comportement des particules dans le plasma en considérant trois phénomènes physiques principaux :

• Fusion et sphéroïdisation : établir le bilan énergétique entre le plasma et les particules afin de déterminer les conditions permettant leur fusion complète et leur transformation en particules sphériques.

• Évaporation du magnésium : modéliser la perte préférentielle de Mg lorsque les particules atteignent des températures élevées, en reliant température, temps de séjour et cinétique d'évaporation.

• Coalescence : étudier les collisions et la fusion entre particules en vol afin de prédire leur évolution granulométrique.

Ces trois phénomènes seront ensuite couplés dans une approche d'optimisation multi-objectifs, afin d'identifier les conditions permettant de maximiser la sphéroïdisation tout en limitant la perte de Mg, la formation de nanoparticules et l'élargissement de la distribution granulométrique.

Le travail comportera une forte interaction entre modélisation et expérimentation. Les prédictions seront confrontées à des essais réalisés sur la TekSphero-40 et à la caractérisation des poudres par MEB, diffraction laser, mesure de densité apparente et ICP-AES. Un plan d'expériences sera notamment utilisé pour calibrer et valider les modèles.

Activités principales :

1.Acquérir des connaissances sur le procédé de sphéroïdisation plasma RF

2.Développer les modèles physiques

3. Développer une approche de modélisation numérique

4. Mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'optimisation

5.Conduire et analyser les expérimentations


Diplôme requis pour les contractuels : doctorat

Spécialité/domaine (facultatif) : génie des procédés, génie mécanique, science et génie des matériaux, métallurgie, physique des plasmas, thermique et énergétique, mécanique des fluides ou domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience directe en plasma thermique ou en sphéroïdisation de poudres serait appréciée, mais elle n'est pas indispensable. Le candidat devra surtout posséder une solide formation scientifique lui permettant d'acquérir rapidement les connaissances spécifiques au procédé.

Connaissances :

Le/la candidat(e) devra disposer de bonnes bases dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : transferts thermiques, thermodynamique, mécanique des fluides, phénomènes de transport, science des matériaux et métallurgie, modélisation physique, méthodes numériques, statistiques et plans d'expériences.

Une bonne compréhension des phénomènes de changement de phase, de transfert de chaleur, de transport de matière et de cinétique est particulièrement recherchée.

Le projet nécessite également une capacité à passer d'une description physique du phénomène à un modèle mathématique exploitable numériquement.

Savoir-être :

Nous recherchons un(e) jeune chercheur(se) autonome, curieux(se) et capable d'aborder un problème physique complexe, de formuler des hypothèses, de développer un modèle, de le confronter à l'expérience et de l'améliorer sur la base des résultats obtenus.

Le poste offre la possibilité de travailler à l'interface de plusieurs domaines : Plasma RF → Transferts thermiques → Métallurgie des poudres → Modélisation → Expérimentation → Optimisation → Fabrication additive.

Cycle hebdomadaire de 37,30 H - 48,5 jours de congés - aménagement possible du temps de travail sur 4,5 jours - télétravail sous conditions.
