description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

  • Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.

We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.

The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Kundenanforderungen, Erkenntnissen aus der Nutzerforschung, Konzeption und visueller Umsetzung: Du denkst Design strategisch, treibst Design-Prozesse voran und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit einem hohen Maß an visueller Präzision – auch an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gestaltung und technischer Umsetzung. Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen.   • Du übernimmst die kreative Federführung bei Angeboten und Ausschreibungen und präsentierst in Pitches
  • Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt im Designprozess ein und teilst deine Erfahrungen im Team
  • Du übernimmst du die fachliche Leitung kleiner UX/UI-Teams in Kundenprojekten, gibst Impulse ins Team durch Design Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Mentoring von Kolleg:innen

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungsteams in agilen Umfeldern sowie in der Moderation von Workshops und Präsentation von Designlösungen gegenüber Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
  • Aussagekräftiges Portfolio, in dem du deine Arbeit von der Problemstellung bis zum finalen Interface sowie deine Erfahrung mit Designsystemen zeigst
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. 
Nice-to-haves
  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen wie Public Sector, Health, Energie.
  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung kleiner Designteams in Kundenprojekten.
  • Erfahrung in der Art Direktion
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Produkten, Designprozessen, Prototyping oder Code-Generierung.

Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content.
Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs.
  • Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen.
  • Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter.
  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.
  • Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen.
  • Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs.

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.


Your Mission

  • End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.
  • Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.
  • Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.
  • Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments.
  • Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset
  • Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. 
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures.
  • Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Hands-on experience building AI into products (structured extraction, automation, RAG, or agentic workflows), not just using AI coding assistants.
  • Strong engineering quality mindset, with experience building reliable, maintainable products and validating them through appropriate testing.
  • Strong product sense — you understand business processes and the user perspective, not just the code.
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with stakeholders at all levels and driving adoption of the solutions you build.
  • Proactive mindset with strong autonomy and initiative in a dynamic environment 
  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus.


Why Us?

  • An awesome team & great vibes
    • Work with motivated colleagues in an agile, ambitious, and friendly atmosphere where collaboration and fun go hand in hand with high speed.
  • Flat hierarchies & real growth opportunities
    • Take ownership of your role and develop personally alongside the company. We promote from within and value every voice, regardless of seniority or title.
  • Modern workplace & cutting-edge equipment
    • State-of-the-art office setup including adjustable desks, mobile treadmills, air conditioning, and everything you need to excel in your role.
  • Company pension program (bAV)
    • Smart pension plan with a 30% Buying Labs grant on your contribution—investing in your financial future together.
  • Corporate Benefits membership
    • Access exclusive discounts from a wide range of partner brands and retailers.
  • Full "Deutschlandticket" coverage
    • We cover the complete cost (ca. €60/month) so you can travel sustainably and conveniently throughout Germany.
  • Free bike options
    • Choose between a complimentary "Swapfiets" bike (original or deluxe 7) or opt for JobRad bike-leasing with an additional €26/month grant from Buying Labs.
  • Complimentary food & beverages
    • Free Friday lunch in the office, plus organic fruit & vegetables, drinks, snacks, coffee/tea, healthy shots and seasonal treats (e.g. ice cream, soups) throughout the week.
  • Personalized workspace setup
    • €100 welcome voucher to customize and optimize your workspace from day one.
  • Refer-A-Friend (employee referral program)
    • You love being part of Buying Labs? Fantastic! Then recommend people from your personal network and receive attractive rewards.
Sounds like a perfect fit? We can’t wait to meet you – apply now and be part of our journey!

title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
description:
Über tonies:

tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

Internal Tech Stack:

CRM: Hubspot

Automation: N8N, Clay

Outreach: Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

AI Tooling: Claude Co-work/Code
Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

  • Proactive & Strategic Problem-Solving: A track record of independently identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks in processes, leading to measurable improvements in efficiency.

  • Operational Excellence & Project Ownership: Exceptional organisational skills with a demonstrated capability to manage multiple, high-priority projects concurrently, ensuring successful delivery within tight deadlines.

Nice to have’s

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field.

  • Expertise in Growth Stack Technologies: Hands-on experience and familiarity with core automation, analytics, and CRM systems, including specific platforms like Hubspot, N8N, Clay, Lemlist, and Make.

  • Content & Social: Experience running a company's or organisation's LinkedIn presence, or writing experience with an audience behind it - a newsletter or blog of your own.

  • Start-up Experience: Experience in a commercial or operational role in a startup or scaleup.

     

How we support you

You will work with

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are seeking outstanding Executive / VIP Business Travel Consultants to deliver an elite, seven-star service experience to senior leaders, executives, and high-value corporate clients. This role is designed for someone who understands that Executive Travel is not transactional it is highly personalised, time-critical, and relationship-driven.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in hospitality, premium travel, or luxury customer service, paired with a solid understanding of contact centre operations where productivity, efficiency, and CSAT must coexist. You will be comfortable operating at pace, managing complex itineraries, and making confident decisions on behalf of discerning clients.

You will have strong GDS experience though we are able to provide full cross platform training for candidates who have experience in Amadeus, Sabre or another GDS.

This role is offered either as:

Hub based on hybrid 3 days IRL - permanent contract
OR

Fully remote - if working as a 2-year fixed-term contract

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivering a seamless, proactive, and anticipatory experience for Executive and VIP travellers

  • Acting as a trusted advisor, not just a booking agent

  • Managing highly complex, often last-minute travel changes with calm professionalism

  • Consistently achieving strong CSAT while meeting productivity and efficiency expectations

  • Demonstrating excellent ownership, judgement, and accountability in every interaction

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-end management of Executive and VIP corporate travel, including air, hotel, ground transport, and bespoke requests

  • Providing expert recommendations aligned to traveller preferences, company policy, and duty of care

  • Handling urgent and high-impact travel disruptions with speed, empathy, and precision

  • Managing multiple channels (phone, chat, email) in a fast-paced Executive Care environment

  • Balancing premium service delivery with operational KPIs such as productivity, handle time, and SLA adherence

  • Building long-term relationships with Executive travellers through consistent, high-quality service

  • Collaborating closely with peers to maintain a high-performance, elite service culture

What We’re Looking For

Essential:

  • Proven experience delivering high-touch, premium customer service (Executive travel, hospitality, aviation, luxury brands, or similar)

  • GDS experience (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo or similar)

  • Strong understanding of contact centre performance metrics, including productivity, efficiency, and CSAT

  • Exceptional communication skills with a polished, confident, and discreet style

  • Ability to remain calm, decisive, and solutions-focused in high-pressure situations

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

Desirable:

  • Experience supporting senior stakeholders, C-suite, or high-net-worth individuals

  • Exposure to out-of-hours, follow-the-sun, or on-call travel support models

Personal Attributes

  • Naturally service-oriented with a strong hospitality mindset

  • High emotional intelligence and sound judgement

  • Comfortable working autonomously and taking full ownership

  • Resilient, adaptable, and confident handling ambiguity

  • Commercially aware and performance-driven without compromising service quality

To note - the work schedule for this role is currently between 8am-8pm Monday-Friday with a rotational weekend shift.

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 90 min Virtual or IRL depending on your location
Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. Checkout.com and the CEO Office

Checkout.com is building the future of payments.

Our global, multi-product payments network helps businesses move money, improve acceptance, manage fraud and turn payments into a competitive advantage. Headquartered in London, with offices around the world, Checkout.com is trusted by leading brands including eBay, DocuSign, Vinted, Uber, Klarna, Wise, Pinterest, Grab and Sony.

This is a career-defining opportunity at a generation-defining company. There is no finish line at Checkout.com: we set ambitious goals, build with intent and move at speed, always guided by our values as we work to create a brighter future for payments across the online ecosystem.

The role


We are scaling a high-impact Strategy & Operations team within the CEO Office to strengthen product delivery and execution across the business.

As a Manager, Strategy & Operations, you will be a hands-on operator embedded in a designated Product team or pillar. Working alongside Product, Engineering and other functions, you will lead complex strategic and operational initiatives, align stakeholders, manage dependencies, resolve blockers and drive delivery from planning through launch. This is a business execution and operating leadership role—not primarily a consulting or process-improvement role.

You will use data and first-principles thinking to identify root causes, design practical solutions and build scalable operating mechanisms. The role offers high visibility with the CEO and executive team, with opportunities to grow into broader responsibilities across Product, Technology and the wider organisation.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Drive strategic initiatives: Lead major cross-functional projects, create alignment, clarify ownership, manage risks and make sure initiatives launch effectively.

  • Build scalable operating mechanisms: Develop practical standards and processes for planning, testing, launch readiness, governance, reporting and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Improve measurable business outcomes: Take ownership of specific processes or metrics where there is a clear opportunity to improve speed, quality or scalability.

Success means owning and delivering meaningful business projects—not simply diagnosing problems or redesigning processes in isolation. We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs.   • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Experience designing APIs, platform reliability, and building products at scale

  • Bonus: experience deploying products directly to enterprise customers, or ML/GenAI exposure

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75). 

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.
  • Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes.
  • Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers.
  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
  • Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe.


Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet :

  • Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement.
  • Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.).
  • Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow.
  • Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle.
  • Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées.
  • Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP.
  • Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact.
  • Compétences en visualisation de données pour restituer vos analyses de manière claire.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), structuré(e) et avez un fort esprit d'équipe.
  • Force de proposition : vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où il reste des choses à construire.


Ce que ce stage vous apportera :

  • Une montée en compétences technique pointue en Python et SQL.
  • L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack data moderne et robuste (AWS, Redshift, Metaflow, Git, etc.).
  • Le passage de la théorie à la pratique : vous verrez votre code et vos modèles partir en production.
  • L’affinage de votre sens métier et de votre esprit critique au contact d'équipes variées (Tech, E-commerce, CRM, Marketing).

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

title: Graduate program | French market (Paris)
description:
Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale française, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en forte demande : tous les cabinets français cherchent une réponse à l'IA, et les usages ne sont pas encore stabilisés.

  • Une équipe qui se construit : vous entrez tôt et vous pesez sur la façon dont on vend.

  • Une vraie école de vente : un parcours structuré, du coaching hebdomadaire et des objectifs clairs à chaque étape.

Vos responsabilités

Pour soutenir notre croissance, nous lançons un Graduate Program – Sales conçu pour les 3 % de jeunes talents les plus ambitieux.

Ce n'est pas un poste junior classique. C'est un parcours accéléré, avec des rotations structurées et un objectif clair : faire de vous un Account Executive performant en 18 mois, avec le soutien de la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Vous passerez par quatre rôles consécutifs, chacun avec ses objectifs, son coaching et ses KPI :

3 à 6 mois – SDR (Sales Development Representative)

  • Qualifier les leads inbound.

  • Apprendre les bases de la discovery, la qualification d'opportunités et le passage de relais à l'AE.

6 mois – BDR (Business Development Representative)

  • Apprendre à générer du pipeline à partir de zéro.

  • Maîtriser la prospection, les séquences outbound, le premier contact et la prise de rendez-vous.

Le point de bascule

Après vos neuf premiers mois, en fonction de vos performances, de vos points forts et des compétences acquises, vous rejoindrez l'une des deux trajectoires suivantes :

6 mois – AE Inbound

  • Gérer les deals inbound sur notre segment juridique.

  • Mener les calls de discovery et les démos, traiter les objections et closer vos premiers clients.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les AE seniors, le Sales Coach et le Sales Director sur des deals en cours et sur la stratégie.

6 mois – AE Outbound

  • Prendre la responsabilité d'un territoire.

  • Piloter des deals outbound de bout en bout, avec plusieurs interlocuteurs et des cycles plus longs.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les scripts, les séquences et les playbooks au fil de vos apprentissages.

Tout au long du programme, vous serez formé et coaché au sein de la Lexroom Sales Academy, avec des modules structurés sur :

  • la méthodologie de vente (discovery, démo, négociation, traitement des objections) ;

  • la gestion du pipeline et du territoire ;

  • l'usage de l'IA dans la vente ;

  • la performance personnelle, le mindset et la communication.

Les meilleurs profils seront fast-trackés vers des rôles mid-market, enterprise ou managériaux.

Le profil que nous cherchons

  • Jeune diplômé (ou jusqu'à 1 an d'expérience) avec un vrai intérêt pour la vente B2B et la tech / l'IA.

  • Vous avez toujours été parmi les meilleurs dans ce que vous avez fait : études, sport, projets, travail.

  • Excellentes qualités de communication, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Français langue maternelle (ou C1+), anglais courant (B2 minimum, pour travailler avec les équipes transverses).

  • Drive et résilience : les objectifs ambitieux vous motivent et le "non" ne vous fait pas peur.

  • Vous apprenez vite, vous posez les questions qui dérangent et vous allez chercher le feedback.

  • Vous voulez des responsabilités tôt, pas une ligne "programme graduate" sur votre CV.

Ce que nous offrons

  • 45 000 55 000 € OTE, variable non plafonné et accéléré.

  • Equity : un package de stock-options.

  • 3 jours d'onboarding en présentiel à Milan, entièrement pris en charge.

  • Mutuelle d'entreprise (Alan) : prise en charge à 60 % par l'employeur.

  • Titres-restaurant (Swile) : 12 € par jour (pris en charge à 60 % par l'employeur).

  • Pass Navigo : pris en charge à 50 % par l'employeur.

  • Wellpass : abonnement sport & bien-être (cofinancé par l'employeur).

  • Programme Erasmus : 1 semaine par an, vol et logement pris en charge, pour travailler depuis nos bureaux de Madrid, Barcelone, Milan, Rome, Berlin ou Sofia.

  • Modèle hybride : entre le télétravail et notre bureau parisien.

Le process

  • Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours.

  • Entretien commercial : potentiel et sens commercial.

  • Mise en situation : approche et résilience.

  • Entretien final : valeurs et culture.

  • Offre.

Chez Lexroom, nous sommes portés par des ambitions fortes et une exigence d'excellence. Nous construisons quelque chose de grand, et cela demande de l'engagement, du travail et une vraie envie de progresser. Si ce défi vous parle, nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Le profil que nous cherchons

  • 6 à 12 mois d'expérience en vente outbound B2B SaaS, ou un vrai track record de SDR top performer. Le poste reste ouvert aux profils en début de carrière qui ont l'énergie, la discipline et la "faim" commerciale.
