title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).
  • Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.
  • Berlin-based or willing to relocate.
This role is not for you if…
  • You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.
  • You resist working in code or with AI.
  • You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.
  • You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.

Interview process:

  1. First Call — Intro on what we do with Max (Hiring manager) 
  2. Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Sebastian (Designer) 
  3. Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Product team (group call)
  4. On-site Day — Meet our team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.
  5. (Potentially) quick ,,vibe check'' call- with founder (Leonie or Hendrik)


Why us?

What you can expect

  • Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership
  • Varied day-to-day → every problem comes with unique needs, so no two days are the same
  • Visible impact → you'll see the direct results of your work for both our customers and traide AI
  • Direct impact on product → your decisions ship and shape what users touch every day
  • Flexible working → we work in a hybrid mode, with an office in senfelderplatz and home office options. 
  • Be part of our regular team events (boat trips, bowling, etc.)

title: Founding Engineer - atmo (Berlin-based / Hybrid)
description:
At atmo, we've built a core AI product at the intersection of agricultural transition and green finance. As an early-stage company moving from first rollout to scale, we're looking for a hands-on Founding Engineer to join our founding team and help build the AI backbone of our product.

Over the past year, we've deliberately evolved from a pure data product into an AI-first platform. AI is now central to everything we do - from ingesting messy, real-world agricultural data to unlocking new financing flows for sustainable farming. We're looking for someone who wants to get hands-on: building and managing the AI agents that power the product, and working closely with our CSO to turn science models into shipped features.

About atmo

atmo is building the infrastructure for financing the transition of agriculture.

Agriculture is facing massive pressure to adapt - from climate change and rising input costs to new technologies and changing market requirements. Yet farmers and their financing partners often lack the data, tools and business cases needed to make the right investment decisions.

atmo is an AI-powered Agriculture Finance OS that brings farm, climate and financial data together to turn complex agricultural transition investments into clear, bankable business cases. Our platform helps farmers identify profitable transition opportunities, assess ROI and financing needs, access relevant solution providers and generate bank-ready financing reports. For banks and other financial institutions, atmo provides the data and decision intelligence needed to confidently finance the next generation of agricultural investments.

We work across the agricultural ecosystem, including farmers, banks, solution providers and food companies, and are already active in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with partnerships and pilots across leading financial and agricultural organisations.

Founded in Berlin in 2023, atmo is backed by leading investors, accelerators and non-dilutive funding programmes. We are a lean, ambitious team combining deep expertise in agriculture, finance, climate science, AI and B2B SaaS - with the goal of making agricultural transition investable at scale.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Build, run and continuously improve the LLM pipelines at the heart of atmo's product - classifying farm records, soil samples and financial statements, extracting structured data from them, and generating bank-ready reports - from prompting and orchestration to evaluation and monitoring
  • Own the platform end-to-end: a Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js web apps and the AWS infrastructure they run on
  • Partner closely with our CSO on the scientific engine, defining the interface between science and product and turning new models into production-ready features
  • Make AI outputs trustworthy: evaluations, guardrails and clear provenance, so every number in a financing case can be traced back to its source
  • Ship fast and iterate constantly, using modern AI tooling to move with a small, high-leverage team

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on builder - you'd rather be in the codebase than in a meeting
  • Strong Python backend depth (FastAPI or similar, SQL, background jobs), comfortable across the stack in TypeScript/Next.js and owning infrastructure on AWS
  • Practical experience running LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes: structured extraction, evaluation, cost and latency, handling failures gracefully
  • Comfortable working directly with scientific/domain experts, like our CSO, to turn models into shipped features
  • Fast-paced, get-it-done mindset - thrives in ambiguity and on a lean team, and takes ownership of technical decisions, not just tickets
  • Mission-aligned: genuine interest in climate, sustainable agriculture, and green finance
  • Bonus: exposure to fintech, agritech, or applied climate/agricultural science; German helps, as much of our farm data is German

Benefits

Why atmo

Building at atmo means shaping both the technology and the science behind it, side by side with the founding team. This role gives you the chance to:

  • Own the AI and data layer of a real climate-impact product, with real farmers and banks on the other end
  • Work side by side with the founding team and our CSO, shaping both product and science
  • A startup-stage compensation package with meaningful equity and substantial ownership from day oneSmall team (5 FTE), real impact, no layers

📍 Location: Hybrid, with a preference for London / Berlin
🌱 Womxn are encouraged to apply

If you're excited to build the AI and systems behind real climate and finance impact - we'd love to hear from you.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing (m/f/d)
description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing you own paid acquisition at Placetel. You bring in the trials and the paying customers that our self-service growth model runs on – with real budget responsibility, across Google, Meta and every channel we have not tested yet.

One thing up front, because it shapes how we work: winning SMB customers in Germany looks far more like winning customers for a DTC brand than like classic enterprise B2B. High volume, short consideration cycles, creative-led, measured daily. That is how we run growth – and that is the mindset we are hiring for.

What you will do

  • Own our paid acquisition budget end to end – strategy, channel mix, allocation and daily optimisation – and be accountable for the outcome.
  • Plan, launch and scale campaigns across Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube) and Meta, plus additional channels such as LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, native, affiliate and comparison portals.
  • Manage to unit economics, not vanity metrics: trials, trial-to-paid, CAC, payback period and LTV/CAC are your scoreboard.
  • Build a systematic testing cadence – audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, creative angles – with clear hypotheses, decision rules and documented learnings.
  • Work hand in hand with our Creative Strategist: you brief which angles to test, you read the results, you decide what scales and what dies.
  • Own tracking, attribution and measurement together with our analytics and eCommerce colleagues – GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, conversion values, offline conversion uploads from the CRM.
  • Optimise the full path from ad to trial to paid customer: landing pages, signup flow, offers and pricing tests – together with Growth, Product and Sales.
  • Open up channels we do not run yet and decide quickly whether they earn a permanent budget line.
  • Report performance transparently and in plain language: what worked, what did not, what we do next.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years of hands-on performance marketing with genuine budget responsibility – ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in a DTC or high-velocity consumer brand. Both together is the strongest profile we can imagine for this role.
  • Pro in one channel, solid in the rest. You are the person others ask about Google Ads or Meta, and you can competently run the other channels yourself.
  • You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary.
  • Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to.
  • A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it.
  • Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared.
  • Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs; you need to feel the language they are being sold in.
  • A degree in marketing, business, business informatics or a comparable field – or an equivalent track record that speaks for itself.

Optional and nice to have

  • Experience with free-trial or freemium subscription models and self-service checkout.
  • Experience with comparison portals, affiliate and marketplace channels in Germany.
  • Experience running paid in more than one market or language.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Full ownership of a meaningful acquisition budget and direct, visible impact on growth and revenue.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • A company that is deliberately building a digital, self-service growth model – you will not be fighting the organisation to run modern growth.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

title: Werkstudent*in Public Sector - KI Strategie & Innovation
description:
Unsere Mission

dida ist eine der führenden Machine Learning Agenturen mit Aufträgen und Projekten in der Wissenschaft, der Industrie und dem öffentlichen Sektor. Unser Team, das überwiegend aus Machine Learning Scientists besteht, trägt zu neuen Erkenntnissen und Innovationen im Bereich Künstlicher Intelligenz bei. 
Wir wollen zu einer bewussten Entwicklung und Integration von Machine Learning in allen Gesellschaftsbereichen beitragen. 
Werde Teil unseres Public Sector Teams und unterstütze uns dabei, öffentliche KI-Digitalprojekte bei Ministerien, Krankenkassen oder Ämtern auf EU, Bundes- und Landesebene zu gewinnen und damit die Verwaltung der Zukunft mitzugestalten. 

Du wirst:

  • Im Kundenkontakt zu öffentlichen Bedarfsträgern, durch deine Vorbereitung von und Teilnahme an Terminen, unterstützen.

  • Und der technischste Teil (kein Muss): Bei der Gestaltung von KI-Projektkonzepten im Zusammenspiel mit unseren Machine Learning Scientists mitwirken.


Dein Profil

  • Du studierst in einem wirtschaftlichen oder technischen Studiengang und interessierst dich für Technik und ihre Anwendung.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast Lust darauf, Erfahrungen am Kunden zu machen: Chancen erkennen, auf Menschen zugehen, Angebote mitentwickeln.

  • Kein Muss, aber ein Plus: du hast bereits unternehmerische Initiative gezeigt oder erste Berührungspunkte mit der Geschäftsentwicklung gehabt. 

  • Wenn du in Berlin wohnst ist das ein Plus, du studierst mind. noch 3 Semester und möchtest mindestens 16 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten.

  • Dein Deutsch ist mindestens auf C1-Niveau; gleichzeitig kannst du dich mit Kolleg*innen im Unternehmen auf Englisch verständigen. Ohne mindestens C1 können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen.


Warum du dich für uns entscheiden solltest?

  • Setze deine Motivation und dein Engagement in einer Umgebung ein, in der diese wertgeschätzt werden. Du kannst wertvolle Erfahrung im engen Zusammenspiel mit der Unternehmens- und Geschäftsfeldleitung erwarten.

  • Konzeptioniere spannende Projekte, wie das Identifizieren von illegalen Minen im Regenwald, das Erkennen von Objekten auf Schienen für die Deutsche Bahn, die Entwicklung einer semantischen Suche für das Wirtschaftsserviceportal des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen, das den Bürgern den Zugang zu Dienstleistungen der öffentlichen Verwaltung ermöglicht, oder die KI-gestützte KI-Digitalisierung von Geschäftsvorgängen bei einer großen gesetzlichen Krankenkasse.

title: Werkstudent*in Information Security Awareness & Automation
description:
WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET:

  • spannende Einblicke in die Praxis von Informationssicherheit, Business Continuity Management und Compliance in einem innovativen Software-Projekthaus.

  • eine klar umrissene Aufgabe: Du baust die Formate, mit denen wir Informationssicherheit und Business Continuity im Unternehmen vermitteln – und automatisierst die Arbeit, die dahinter steckt.

  • eigene Themen mit eigener Verantwortung. Du arbeitest nicht auf Zuruf, sondern bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein.

  • eine Aufgabe, in der Kommunikation zählt: Wir übersetzen komplexe Themen in verständliche Sprache.

  • ein kleines, motiviertes Team und erfahrene Kolleg*innen, die dich begleiten – niemand bleibt mit seinen Fragen allein.

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten – in der Klausurenphase auch mit weniger Stunden.


BEI UNS WIRST DU:

  • Schulungs- und Awareness-Formate entwickeln, die wirklich gelesen werden – von Microlearnings über die Intranet-Gestaltung bis zu Onboarding-Unterlagen.

  • Inhalte für unser Business Continuity Management (BCM) gestalten: Rollen- und Notfallkarten, Erstmaßnahmen auf einer Seite, Vorlagen für die Krisenkommunikation. Material, das im Ernstfall in dreißig Sekunden verstanden werden muss.

  • unsere Awareness-Kampagnen und BCM-Übungen mitplanen, begleiten und auswerten: Was hat gewirkt, was wurde ignoriert, was machen wir beim nächsten Mal anders?

  • genau diese Arbeit automatisieren: aus einer Vorgabe KI-gestützt mehrere Formate erzeugen, deutsche und englische Fassungen anlegen und Inhalte nachziehen, sobald sich eine Richtlinie oder ein Notfallplan ändert.

  • Inhalte automatisiert bereitstellen und aktuell halten – im Intranet, in Confluence und in unseren Onboarding-Paketen. Die Workflows dafür baust du mit Jira, Confluence und KI-gestützten Werkzeugen.

  • Recherche zu aktuellen Bedrohungsthemen.

  • die Nachweise für unsere Zertifizierungen nach ISO 27001, ISO 22301 und TISAX in deinem Bereich pflegen und für Audits aufbereiten – Schulungsnachweise, Übungsprotokolle und die Nachverfolgung der Lessons Learned.

  • interne und externe Audits begleiten: Nachweise zusammenstellen, Auditfragen aufnehmen und die Umsetzung der vereinbarten Maßnahmen nachverfolgen.

  • dich vor allem mit organisatorischen und kommunikativen Themen beschäftigen. Unser Beitrag zur Sicherheit besteht aus Konzepten, Texten, Prozessen und Automatisierungen – die Systeme selbst betreuen unsere Kolleg*innen aus der IT. Wenn dich diese Seite der Informationssicherheit, Business Continuity und Compliance reizt, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


WAS DU MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST:

  • laufendes Studium, zum Beispiel IT-Sicherheitsmanagement, (Wirtschafts-/Medien-)Informatik, Sicherheitsmanagement, Corporate Security Management, Risk & Security Management, Corporate Governance, Risk & Compliance oder vergleichbar mit IT-Bezug.

  • Spaß daran, Dinge zu automatisieren – Skripte, Workflows, Prompts.

  • Interesse an Informationssicherheit und Business Continuity mit Schwerpunkt auf organisatorischen Fragestellungen. Vorkenntnisse in ISO 27001, ISO 22301 oder TISAX sind nicht erforderlich.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • die Bereitschaft, 16–20 Stunden pro Woche zu arbeiten, in den Semesterferien auch gerne mehr.


DEINE EXTRAS BEI UNS:

  • flexible Arbeitsmodelle im Hinblick auf Zeit und Ort.

  • moderne Räumlichkeiten mit guter Anbindung.

  • großzügig ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

  • und vieles mehr...

Du willst komplexe Vorgaben so aufschreiben, dass sie im Alltag ankommen – und die Arbeit dahinter automatisieren?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung für die Standorte München oder Rosenheim.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist Digital Analytics (w/m/d)
description:
Your new team:

As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.


What awaits you:

  • You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts.
  • You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers.
  • You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection.
  • You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues.
  • You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process.
  • You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development.
  • You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working.
  • Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.


What you can expect:

At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.

You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups.

You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting.

What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team.


What you bring along:

  • You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups.
  • Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation
  • Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system
  • Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts
  • A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities
  • A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript
  • Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations
  • An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders
  • A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work
  • A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself
We look forward to meeting you!

title: Creative Strategist - Paid Social (m/f/d)
description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Creative Strategist you own the single biggest lever in our paid social performance: the creative. Meta is your home channel. You decide what we test, you make sure enough of it exists, and you read the results well enough to know why the winner won.

We are B2B, but we intend to build like a consumer brand. German SMB owners scroll the same feed as everyone else, and they do not stop for a product screenshot with a feature list. Your job is to make them stop – and then to make them start a trial.

What you will do

  • Own the creative engine for paid social – primarily Meta, with TikTok and YouTube as we expand.
  • Turn insight into angles: mine customer reviews, support tickets, sales calls, churn reasons, competitor ads and customer conversations for what German SMBs actually say about their phone system, their calls and their missed business.
  • Build and run a creative testing roadmap: a steady, predictable volume of new concepts every week, structured by angle, format and hook so results are readable rather than anecdotal.
  • Write scripts, hooks and storyboards for short-form video – UGC, founder- and employee-led, testimonial, problem/solution, product demo, static and everything in between.
  • Brief and direct creators, editors, actors and freelancers, run shoots, and manage the production pipeline end to end so throughput never becomes the bottleneck.
  • Analyse creative performance at the right level with the Performance Marketing Manager – hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and trial rate per angle – and decide what to iterate, scale or kill.
  • Maintain a living library of winners, losers and learnings so we compound instead of restarting every quarter.
  • Systematically tear down what works elsewhere – in DTC, in consumer, at other AI and SaaS brands – and transfer the pattern to us.
  • Keep everything on brand and legally clean while still being genuinely entertaining.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • A track record of paid social creative that actually performed at scale, above all on Meta. Bring examples – and the numbers behind them.
  • You think in hooks and in the first three seconds. You can explain why an ad works, not just that it does.
  • You write and judge German copy at native level; solid English on top.
  • Production-capable, not only conceptual: when speed matters you can shoot and cut a usable ad yourself.
  • Comfortable with volume – dozens of variations a month, not three perfect films a quarter.
  • Data-literate: you can navigate Ads Manager reporting and draw your own conclusions without waiting for a dashboard.
  • Strong opinions about creative, loosely held – you let the results decide and you kill your darlings quickly.
  • Agency or in-house experience at a DTC, consumer or high-velocity SaaS brand is a strong plus.

Optional - nice to have

  • Experience building and managing a creator or UGC network.
  • Experience with AI-supported creative production (generative video, voice, image, automated variation).
  • Experience with landing page and post-click creative, not just the ad itself.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Real creative ownership: you set the testing agenda, not an agency.
  • A budget that makes creative testing meaningful and a performance team that will actually read your results.
  • The freedom to build a B2B brand that behaves like a consumer brand – with an AI-native product that gives you something genuinely new to talk about.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

title: Pflichtpraktikum als CRM-Manager für B2B Software (m/w/d)
description:
CENDAS wurde 2021 mit der Vision gegründet, Bauprojekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu digitalisieren. Unsere Software verbindet echtes Handwerk mit digitalen Prozessen: Vorbereitung, Abwicklung, Steuerung – alle Phasen des Bauprojekts in einer Anwendung. Heute setzen wir als schnell wachsendes Scale-Up mit unserem internationalen Team aus rund 65 Expert:innen neue Maßstäbe für Effizienz und Innovation in der Bauindustrie.

Bei uns kannst du echten Start-up-Spirit erleben und gleichzeitig von strukturierten Prozessen profitieren. Unser Vertriebsteam bietet dir die Möglichkeit, aktiv an unseren Vertriebs- und Marketingprozessen mitzuwirken. Wenn du in einem flexiblen, innovativen und schnell wachsenden Unternehmen echte Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen deines Pflichtpraktikums steigst du in die operative CRM-Arbeit eines wachsenden B2B-SaaS-Unternehmens ein und lernst, wie Kunden- und Vertriebsprozesse datenbasiert gesteuert werden.

Konkret übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

  • Reporting und Dashboards: Du baust bestehende Reports und Dashboards aus, pflegst sie eigenständig und wertest wiederkehrende Kennzahlen für unsere Vertriebs- und Kundenteams aus. Dieser Bereich ist für CENDAS besonders wichtig, da er die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen bildet.
  • Workflows und Automatisierung: Du konzipierst, baust und testest Workflows und Listenlogiken in unserem CRM-System und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Abläufe zu automatisieren.

  • Eigenes Projekt: In der zweiten Hälfte deines Praktikums übernimmst du ein abgrenzbares Thema mit sichtbarem Ergebnis – zum Beispiel einen Lifecycle-Report, eine Datenqualitäts-Scorecard oder einen Onboarding-Automatismus.

  • Du brauchst ein Pflichtpraktikum – und willst in der Zeit wirklich etwas bewegen, nicht nur Meetings protokollieren.
  • Strukturiert und systematisch zu arbeiten ist für dich kein Zwang, sondern dein natürlicher Modus.
  • Deutsch beherrschst du sicher in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern packst Dinge eigenständig an.
  • Du willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern aktiv an unseren CRM-Prozessen und Wachstumssystemen mitwirken – in einem Team, das Tempo mag.

Praktikumsdauer: Die Dauer des Praktikums richtet sich nach den Vorgaben deiner Universität.

Benefits

Unser Angebot:

  • Remote-First: Arbeite, von wo du willst – zuhause, unterwegs oder in unserem Coworking Space in Bochum.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Feste Kernzeiten fürs Team, den Rest gestaltest du so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt.
  • Start-up-Feeling: Du bist von Tag eins an mittendrin statt nur dabei – deine Meinung zählt wirklich.
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser – wir bringen dir das nötige Know-how gezielt bei, damit du schnell loslegst.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CRM-Verantwortlichen und bekommst Einblicke, die du im Studium so nicht bekommst.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin und die geplante Dauer deines Praktikums – am einfachsten über das Formular.

Ein Motivationsschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schreib uns stattdessen zwei, drei Sätze: Was interessiert dich an CRM, und welches Tool hast du dir schon mal selbst beigebracht?

Du hörst innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von uns.

title: Growth Marketing Manager - Automation (m/f/d)
description:
About Placetel

We are all connected by one goal: making communication simple. Placetel stands for modern, innovative, AI-native communication and CX solutions from the cloud. More than 40,000 business customers use Placetel every day to call and collaborate successfully – whether in the office, at home or on the go. Since our founding in 2008 we have grown continuously and are today part of Gamma Communications. Together we are changing the way people work around the world. Today and in the future.

Tasks

Your role

As Growth Marketing Manager – Automation you own the automated systems that carry a user from first signup through activation to expansion – and the CRM and AI infrastructure underneath them. Our growth model is self-service and low-touch by design. That only works if the machine behind it is genuinely good.

HubSpot sits at the centre of that machine, connected to product usage data, billing and our web and trial funnel. Your job is to make it do more, do it automatically, and do it with AI agents built natively into the flow – not bolted on as an afterthought.

We are deliberately open on the shape of this role. There are two ways to be excellent at it, and we will build the role around whichever one you bring.

What you will do – the core

  • Own our marketing and sales automation stack, with HubSpot (Marketing + Sales Hub) at the centre and clean connections to product, billing, website and trial funnel.
  • Design, build and continuously improve automated journeys across the whole lifecycle: trial onboarding, activation nudges, lead scoring and routing, upsell and cross-sell, win-back and churn prevention.
  • Replace manual processes with automation – every recurring task a human does today is a candidate, in marketing and in sales.
  • Build AI agents into the funnel natively: qualification, enrichment, routing, response drafting, content generation. Not just AI features inside HubSpot.
  • Keep our data trustworthy: lifecycle stages, attribution and product-usage signals flowing reliably between systems.
  • Measure what you build – every journey has a metric, a baseline and an iteration plan.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Growth Analytics and eCommerce, and make their work easier by removing manual steps from it.

Two possible focus areas – pick yours

You should be strong in one of these and comfortable in the other. Tell us in your application which one is yours.

Focus A – Technical / AI Automation

  • You architect HubSpot rather than just operate it: data model, custom objects and properties, APIs, webhooks, integrations.
  • You build automations beyond HubSpot too – with workflow tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) and with LLM and agent frameworks.
  • You are comfortable with APIs, JSON and enough Python or JavaScript to ship something yourself instead of queueing behind engineering.
  • You have already built working agentic automations, not just prototyped with a chat interface.

Focus B – Lifecycle & Content Automation

  • You own the content inside the journeys: onboarding series, activation emails, in-product messaging, nurture and reactivation tracks.
  • You write German copy that sounds like a person wrote it, not a workflow – and you use AI to produce more of it, faster, without losing that.
  • You design journeys around real user behaviour and know which message at which moment actually moves the metric.
  • You are relentless about testing subject lines, timing, triggers and sequencing.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

  • Several years in marketing and sales automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing ops or CRM – ideally in B2B SaaS with a self-service or product-led motion.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, custom properties and objects, lists, lifecycle stages, reporting. You know where its limits are and how to work around them.
  • Clear strength in one of the two focus areas above and solid working knowledge of the other.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI agents and automation – you have already built things with LLMs, not only read about them.
  • Analytical and structured, with a low tolerance for manual, repetitive processes.
  • Fluent German and English. Our customers are German SMBs and much of the journey content is in German.
  • Self-starter who can carry several topics in parallel and finish them.

Optional - nice to have

  • Experience integrating product usage data into CRM-driven journeys (PQL scoring, usage-based triggers).
  • Experience with data warehouses, reverse ETL or event pipelines.
  • Experience migrating or rebuilding a CRM setup rather than only maintaining one.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A genuinely central role: what you automate defines how our whole growth motion scales.
  • Freedom to choose your tools and to build AI-native rather than retrofitting.
  • A young, ambitious team of marketing, product and tech experts with a real growth mentality.
  • Hybrid working model with flexible hours and a genuine remote culture – we care about output, not attendance.
  • Extensive learning and development opportunities across growth, SaaS and AI.
  • Central office location in Cologne’s Südstadt, modern workspaces and high-quality equipment. Water, coffee and fresh fruit included.
  • Open, collegial company culture with regular team events.

title: Finance & Grants Manager
description:
We’re building the tools to measure soil carbon at scale. As our Finance & Grants Manager, you’ll secure funding for our research and keep our projects and financial reporting stellar.

About Seqana

Seqana builds digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of soil carbon. We combine satellite imagery, an extensive proprietary library of soil data, and machine learning to make soil carbon measurement accurate, cost-effective, and scalable.

Regenerative agriculture can store carbon in soils while improving soil health, water quality, food security, and biodiversity. Measuring that impact is often costly and complex. Our tools help project developers, agrifood companies, NGOs, and governments credibly quantify and report the results of regenerative agricultural practices.

We’re based in Berlin, backed by venture capital investors, and supported by public funding from ESA and DLR.

Aufgaben

As our Finance & Grants Manager, you’ll take ownership of public funding at Seqana, from finding the right programmes and writing applications to coordinating funded projects, reporting, and audits. You’ll also own the financial groundwork that keeps project costs traceable and company reporting reliable.

We run a soil carbon MRV project with the European Space Agency and report to EIT and Rentenbank. You’ll build on that work, developing a funding pipeline that fits our research and turning promising opportunities into strong applications.

You’ll report directly to Stefan, our CEO, and work alongside a fractional CFO who owns forecasting and controlling. You’ll work closely with our scientists, engineers, and colleagues in product and commercial roles. Our subject matter experts provide the technical content; you bring the work together, manage deadlines, AI-Powered knowledge banks and take applications and reports through to submission.

You’ll have room to improve how we coordinate projects, prepare our records, and meet our commitments to funders, investors, and the team. Space agencies, European research funding, and soil carbon: it’s an unusual combination, and a good one.

Grants and public funding

  • Manage our ESA project end to end: monthly progress reports, milestone reviews with our ESA officer, deliverable coordination, time tracking, and cost allocation. Our subject matter experts write the technical content; you own the process, deadlines, and submission.
  • Build and maintain a funding pipeline, score opportunities for fit and potential, and write the applications.
  • Own EIT reporting, EnHANCE requirements, and funder portals. Coordinate funder audits and keep the supporting records complete and ready for review.

External reporting and corporate affairs

  • Produce the reporting packs for our investors and Rentenbank using a consistent set of financial and project data.
  • Own the reporting calendar and coordinate contributions so submissions are complete and on time.
  • Coordinate shareholder resolutions, and notary appointments.

Financial operations

  • Prepare Bookeeping until hand of to our tax firm, with clear notes, correct tax codes, cost centres, and project allocations.
  • Run the monthly close together with our tax firm.
  • Manage SEPA mandates, AWV filings, and self-issued receipts, keeping documentation accurate and up to date.

Qualifikation

  • Experience with European public funding: ESA, EU framework programmes, EIT, national schemes, or comparable programmes. You know what a funder portal, a periodic report, and a cost claim look like from the inside.
  • You’ve written or substantially shaped successful funding applications.
  • Comfort with numbers and financial detail, including cost centres, tax codes, and reconciliations.
  • You plan around fixed deadlines and keep submissions accurate and on time.
  • You can bring together input from busy technical experts and keep work moving without being their manager.
  • Excellent communication skills in German and English.

Nice to have

  • Background in Drittmittelmanagement, Fördermittelmanagement, or kaufmännische Projektabwicklung, for example at a research institute, university, foundation, or consultancy.
  • Experience with audits by a funder or public auditor.
  • Familiarity with DATEV, Lexoffice, Pleo, or comparable tools.
  • Experience in a startup where you’ve built or improved the processes you work with.

Benefits

  • A committed, international team with flat hierarchies, working on a practical contribution to climate action.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing company in a role where your work is visible to everyone.
  • Direct collaboration with the CEO and leadership team.
  • Competitive salary and a permanent, full-time contract.
  • 30 days of paid vacation.
  • €500 annual training budget.
  • Very flexible hours, home-office days, and a casual, pet-friendly office in Berlin-Kreuzberg.
  • Drinks, snacks, team events, and your choice of hardware.

title: People & Operations Manager
description:
We’re building the tools to measure soil carbon at scale. As our People & Operations Manager, you’ll help build a company where people can do good work, grow, and enjoy being part of the team.

**
About Seqana**

Seqana builds digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) of soil carbon. We combine satellite imagery, an extensive proprietary library of soil data, and machine learning to make soil carbon measurement accurate, cost-effective, and scalable.

Regenerative agriculture can store carbon in soils while improving soil health, water quality, food security, and biodiversity. Measuring that impact is often costly and complex. Our tools help project developers, agrifood companies, NGOs, and governments credibly quantify and report the results of regenerative agricultural practices.

We’re based in Berlin, backed by venture capital investors, and supported by public funding from ESA and DLR.

Aufgaben

As our People & Operations Manager, you’ll shape how we hire, support, and develop our team, and own the everyday operations that make Seqana a good place to work. You’ll report directly to Stefan, our CEO, and work closely with the leadership team and everyone across the company.

With a new funding round behind us, we’re developing the structures that will support our next stage of growth. You’ll build on what already works and bring more structure where it helps: an HR system that fits our team, a clear framework for development and progression, and a hiring process that brings the right people on board. You’ll have the space to shape the approach and the responsibility to make it work in practice.

Our team brings together soil scientists, engineers, and people in product and commercial roles, often looking at the same problem from four directions. You’ll help keep that team connected, whether we’re at an offsite or working through an ordinary Tuesday. Together with the leadership team, you’ll shape how we give feedback, support each other, and put our values into practice.

**
People**

  • Own hiring end to end: from shaping job descriptions and sourcing candidates to candidate communication, offers, and contracts.
  • Own the employee lifecycle, with onboarding that is ready for day one and offboarding that is clear, considerate, and well organised.
  • Evolve our growth framework and salary bands, and support the annual review and compensation cycle.
  • Keep a read on how people are doing through check-ins and surveys, and bring forward what leadership needs to hear.
  • Coordinate our team gatherings, from standups and All-Hands to Thursday hangouts, parties, and the annual offsite.
  • Build our employer brand so the right people find us.

**
Operations**

  • Select and introduce an HR system that fits our team, and own migration, rollout, training, and ongoing use.
  • Own the employee tool stack: licences, accounts, access, and costs per person.
  • Coordinate payroll with our tax firm and employer of record (EOR) provider, and own the travel expense process.
  • Coordinate German employment contracts and amendments, visa and immigration cases, and work with our lawyer to move them forward.
  • Administer our VSOP programme.
  • Keep our Kreuzberg office welcoming and running smoothly, as a place where our hybrid team wants to meet, work together, and spend time.

Qualifikation

  • Solid understanding of German employment law, HR practices, and the German administrative system.
  • Excellent communication skills in German and English.
  • You’ve built a process, policy, or system from scratch and seen it through to everyday use.
  • Genuine interest in people and a willingness to give and receive honest feedback.
  • You’re comfortable moving between a leadership discussion and a hands-on task in the same afternoon.
  • Experience in hiring, office management, and event planning.
  • Strong organisational instincts and a habit of following things through.

Nice to have

  • Experience introducing an HR system such as Personio or HiBob.
  • Coaching or workshop facilitation experience.
  • Experience in a startup with 15 to 50 people.

Benefits

  • A committed, international team with flat hierarchies, working on a practical contribution to climate action.
  • The opportunity to shape a growing company in a role where your work is visible to everyone.
  • Direct collaboration with the CEO and leadership team.
  • Competitive salary and a permanent, full-time contract.
  • 30 days of paid vacation.
  • €500 annual training budget.
  • Very flexible hours, home-office days, and a casual, pet-friendly office in Berlin-Kreuzberg.
  • Drinks, snacks, team events, and your choice of hardware.

title: Mitarbeiter Buchungsmanagement & Gästeservice (m/w/d)
description:

Nutze die Chance, Teil unseres wachsenden Teams bei der Homery Living GmbH in Vörstetten zu werden und deine Karriere im strukturierten Umfeld des Unterkunftsmanagements zu gestalten.

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter für unser Operations-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, das Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement unserer Standorte zu steuern, mit Firmenkunden und Gästen zu kommunizieren und einen reibungslosen Ablauf von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise sicherzustellen.

Wenn du kommunikativ und redegewandt bist, gerne mit Kunden und Gästen arbeitest und gleichzeitig Wert auf klare Prozesse und strukturierte Arbeitsabläufe legst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Über Homery Living GmbH

Die Homery Living GmbH mit Sitz in Vörstetten ist spezialisiert auf das Management und die operative Verwaltung von Monteurunterkünften. Wir bieten umfangreiche Dienstleistungen im Bereich Buchungs- und Unterkunftsmanagement an und zeichnen uns durch klare Prozesse und Strukturen aus.

Unser Ansatz ist es, alle operativen Abläufe direkt vom Büro aus zu steuern. Dazu gehören die Gästekommunikation, die Zusammenarbeit mit Firmenkunden sowie die Organisation der Buchungen, Preisgestaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Kalenderverwaltung, Reinigungskoordination und Problemlösung.

Die Homery Living GmbH verwaltet derzeit über 1.000 Betten an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland und gewährleistet durch bewährte Methoden, dokumentierte Prozesse und klare Strukturen stabile und zuverlässige Dienstleistungen.

Unser Unternehmen steht für Qualität, professionelle Abwicklung und den Anspruch, sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter langfristig verlässliche Strukturen zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du steuerst gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team die täglichen Abläufe rund um unsere Monteurunterkünfte. Deine Arbeit findet dabei überwiegend digital und telefonisch von unserem Büro in Vörstetten aus statt.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination von Buchungsanfragen
  • Telefonische und schriftliche Kommunikation mit Firmenkunden und Gästen
  • Erstellung und Versand von Angeboten und Rechnungen
  • Preisverhandlungen mit Kunden
  • Verwaltung und Pflege unserer Buchungskalender
  • Koordination von Reinigungen und weiteren operativen Abläufen
  • Bearbeitung und Lösung auftretender Probleme während eines Aufenthalts
  • Abstimmung mit unserem internen Team sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Ablaufs von der Buchungsanfrage bis zur Abreise

Qualifikation

Welcher berufliche Hintergrund zu uns passt

Besonders gut passt diese Position zu dir, wenn du bereits Erfahrung in der Hotellerie, im Reservierungsmanagement oder in der Gästebetreuung gesammelt hast.

Geeignete berufliche Hintergründe sind beispielsweise:

  • Hotelfachfrau / Hotelfachmann
  • Kaufmann / Kauffrau für Hotelmanagement
  • Reservierungsmitarbeiter / Reservierungsmitarbeiterin
  • Reservation Agent
  • Front Office Agent
  • Front Office Manager
  • Rezeptionist / Rezeptionistin
  • Empfangsmitarbeiter / Empfangsmitarbeiterin im Hotel
  • Guest Service Agent
  • Mitarbeiter / Mitarbeiterin im Reservierungs- oder Buchungsmanagement

Dabei handelt es sich bei uns nicht um eine klassische Tätigkeit an einer Hotelrezeption. Die operative Betreuung unserer Unterkünfte wird zentral aus unserem Büro gesteuert. Der Kontakt zu Kunden und Gästen erfolgt hauptsächlich telefonisch sowie per E-Mail und WhatsApp.

Auch Quereinsteiger mit einem passenden beruflichen Hintergrund und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen können sich bei uns bewerben.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Du bist kommunikativ, überzeugungsstark und redegewandt.
  • Du hast Freude am professionellen Umgang mit Gästen und Firmenkunden.
  • Du kannst bestehenden Prozessen zuverlässig folgen und arbeitest gerne innerhalb klar definierter Abläufe.
  • Du besitzt eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe.
  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig.
  • Du verfügst über starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Du verfügst über eine saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in deutscher Sprache.
  • Du kannst auch bei mehreren gleichzeitig anfallenden Aufgaben strukturiert arbeiten und den Überblick behalten.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsumgebung: Eine durchorganisierte Arbeitsweise für eine effektive und zielorientierte Tätigkeit.
  • Dokumentierte Arbeitsprozesse: Klar nachvollziehbare Abläufe für effiziente und fehlerfreie Arbeitsschritte.
  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeitern langfristig wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine dauerhafte und unbefristete Zusammenarbeit.
  • Leistungsbasierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Bei entsprechender Leistung und persönlicher Entwicklung bestehen klare Möglichkeiten, innerhalb des Unternehmens zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten zur Erweiterung deiner fachlichen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten.
  • Positives und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld: Uns ist wichtig, dass wir gerne miteinander arbeiten, uns gegenseitig unterstützen und gemeinsam an unseren Zielen arbeiten. Wir ziehen an einem Strang, motivieren uns gegenseitig zu guten Leistungen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Für die Position ist ein Bruttogehalt von 3.500 € monatlich vorgesehen.

Unser Büro am Standort Vörstetten

Am Standort Vörstetten erwartet dich auf einer Bürofläche von 140 Quadratmetern ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld. Ausgestattet mit elektrisch höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und modernen Arbeitsgeräten, unterstützt unser Büro optimal deine Arbeitsabläufe.

Das Bürogebäude bietet durch Klimaanlage, Fußbodenheizung und Raumbelüftung eine angenehme und ruhige Arbeitsatmosphäre. Stellplätze direkt vor unserem Bürogebäude machen das Parken einfach und bequem.

Das neu entwickelte Industriegebiet, in dem sich unser Standort befindet, zeichnet sich durch seine ruhige Lage und eine gute Busanbindung aus, die dir eine unkomplizierte Anreise ermöglicht.

Deine Einarbeitung & unsere digitale Schulungsplattform

Für deine Einarbeitung planen wir je nach Vorerfahrung etwa 4 bis 8 Wochen ein.

Du erhältst direkt zum Start Zugriff auf unsere digitale Schulungsplattform, die dir alle notwendigen Inhalte für deine neue Tätigkeit bereitstellt. Die Einarbeitung wird durch die Leitung Operations koordiniert, damit du von Anfang an gezielt in alle relevanten Abläufe eingeführt wirst.

Der erste Teil der Einarbeitung wird persönlich durchgeführt. Ergänzend stehen dir Schulungsvideos, schriftliche Anleitungen und dokumentierte Prozesse zur Verfügung, die deine Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt erklären.

Dadurch weißt du nicht nur, was zu tun ist, sondern kannst bei Fragen jederzeit auf bestehende Abläufe und Anleitungen zurückgreifen. Auch Quereinsteiger können dadurch systematisch in ihre neue Tätigkeit eingearbeitet werden.

Die wichtigsten Eckdaten

Arbeitsort: Vörstetten
Beschäftigungsart: Vollzeit
Vergütung: 3.500 € brutto pro Monat

Unser Shop läuft auf Shopify und wird in den nächsten Monaten von zwei Produkten auf ein Sortiment von rund 60 Artikeln wachsen, mit Bundles, individuellen Landingpages und weiteren Features. Über die Rolle

Die audibene Teleaudiologie ist der am schnellsten wachsende Geschäftsbereich bei audibene. Wir betreuen unsere Kunden von der ersten Beratung bis zur finalen Anpassung vollständig digital im Wohnzimmer der Kunden und bauen dieses Modell gerade in hohem Tempo weiter aus.

Genau hier steigst du ein: Du arbeitest mit uns daran, Kunden in der Hörgeräte-Testphase Mehrwert zu bieten und damit unsere Fitting-to-Sale-Rate zu steigern. Du bekommst eigene Projekte, arbeitest direkt mit dem Management-Team zusammen und siehst innerhalb weniger Wochen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Analysen: Du führst eigenständig quantitative Analysen zu zentralen Kennzahlen durch – etwa zu Rabatten und Pricing, Abbruchraten im Verkaufsprozess, dem durchschnittlichen Warenkorbwert (ABV) oder der Sales-Performance nach Tageszeit und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management ab.
  • Hörtagebuch: Du entwickelst unser Hörtagebuch weiter, das monatlich an über 1.000 Kund:innen verschickt wird. Du begleitest die Optimierung, sammelst Feedback ein und verbesserst das Erlebnis Schritt für Schritt.
  • After Sales Angebote: Du konzipierst operative Workflows für neue Serviceangebote und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Tagesgeschäft wirklich ankommen.
  • Nah am Kunden: Du unterstützt punktuell im telefonischen Kundenkontakt, z. B. beim technischen Setup der Hörerlebnisbox oder bei der Qualifizierung von Studienteilnehmer:innen. So bekommst du ein direktes Gefühl dafür, worüber deine Zahlen eigentlich sprechen.

Wie wir arbeiten

  • Customer First: Jede Entscheidung startet bei der Frage, was sie für unsere Kund:innen besser macht, nicht bei der internen Bequemlichkeit.
  • Ideen testen statt endlos diskutieren: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, und wir probieren sie gemeinsam aus. Bei uns zählt der schnelle Test in der Praxis mehr als das perfekte Konzept auf Folie.
  • Zahlen statt Bauchgefühl: Empfehlungen belegst du mit Daten. Eine gute Intuition ist der Startpunkt, nicht die Begründung.
  • Kollaboration ist der Hebel: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Business Ops, Tech, Logistik, Akustiker:innen und Customer Service zusammen. Gute Lösungen entstehen bei uns nur ganzheitlich.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Lust, dich eigenständig in fachfremde Themen einzuarbeiten von Datenanalyse über Prozessdesign bis Kundenkommunikation.
  • Du bist analytisch und argumentierst mit Zahlen statt aus dem Bauch heraus. Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets (Pivot, Lookups, saubere Datenstrukturen) ist Voraussetzung; ein Gefühl für die betriebswirtschaftliche Interpretation der Daten z. B. Conversion Rates ist ein klares Plus.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Erste Berührungspunkte mit HTML oder CMS-Tools sind ein Plus vor allem zählt, dass du Lust hast, dir Neues beizubringen.
  • Du arbeitest autonom und treibst deine Projekte selbst voran und bist gleichzeitig bereit, von uns stark gefordert und gecoacht zu werden. Wenig Handhalten, viel Verantwortung.
  • Du bist frustrationstolerant: Wenn der erste Weg nicht funktioniert, suchst du den zweiten.
  • Du bist ein Allrounder-Typ: analytisch und technikaffin, aber genauso sicher in der Kommunikation mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und bist fließend in Englisch.
  • Du studierst aktuell (Wirtschaft, Gesundheitsmanagement, o. Ä.) oder hast dein Studium kürzlich abgeschlossen und bringst bereits erste Praktikumserfahrung mit.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Einfluss: Präge das Wachstum von audibene vom ersten Tag an
  • Wachstum: Lerne von unseren Expertinnen und Experten und entwickle Deine Fähigkeiten in unserem GROWTH-Programm, um Deine Karriere aufs nächste Level zu bringen
  • Vertrauen: Erlebe ein hohes Maß an Autonomie und Verantwortung für bereichernde Projekte
  • Dynamisches Umfeld: Wir fördern und unterstützen neue Initiativen, schnelle Entscheidungsfindung und das Eingehen von Risiken
  • Internationales Team: Arbeite mit aufgeschlossenen und internationalen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven einbringen
  • Events: Nimm an unseren regelmäßigen Team-Events, Partys und jährlichen Offsites teil
  • Flexibilität: Genieße eine hybride Arbeitskultur und unser schönes Berliner Office
  • Damit du immer gut an dein Ziel kommst übernehmen wir für alle Mitarbeiter:innen das Deutschland-Ticket

Über audibene:

audibene/hear.com ist das am schnellsten wachsende Hörgeräte-Unternehmen aller Zeiten. Mit unserem einzigartigen digitalen Geschäftsmodell haben wir die Art und Weise der Hörgeräte-Versorgung revolutioniert. Unser Ursprung und Hauptsitz liegen in Deutschland. In den letzten 12 Jahren haben wir uns zu einem international tätigen Unternehmen mit mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeiter:innen entwickelt: an 9 Standorten weltweit von Berlin bis Seoul.

title: Lead Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
This position is part of Novanta’s Advanced Surgery business unit. Specialized in the field of Minimally Invasive Medicine, Novanta Medical develops devices and accessories so that doctors can operate with small cuts. We produce Cameras, Insufflators, Medical Pumps, and tubing that makes diagnosis and treatment easier for everyone. Our insufflators and pump systems dilate cavities in the body and turn previously complicated surgeries into minor procedures. Together with customers, doctors, and technical experts, our teams continuously search for new ways to innovate.

Tasks

Primary Responsibilities

  • Leading software development for medical devices and guiding engineers in the implementation of software solutions
  • Leading the transformation from classical software development to AI-supported software development within the team
  • Requirements analysis based on the functional specification or other requirements
  • Creating and reviewing software requirements and maintaining the required software and device documentation for medical-device development, including documentation needed for compliance, traceability, and product lifecycle support
  • Conducting design and code reviews
  • Independent planning of tasks for oneself and the team
  • Creation and execution of software tests
  • Analysis and correction of software modules in highly complex error cases
  • Applying software standards and ensuring standards within the team
  • Creating and maintaining comprehensive technical and regulatory documentation to ensure compliance with FDA and ISO 13485/IEC 62304 standards
  • Further development of internal software standards
  • Assumption of advanced technical or organizational roles within the organization (e.g., Product Owner)
  • Leading and organizing training sessions on software development practice, tools, and standards
  • Support for strategic decisions in the specialist area through preparation, evaluation, recommendation, and advice

Additional Responsibilities

  • Leading software development for regulated medical devices and supporting engineers in complex implementation decisions
  • Identifying, evaluating, and introducing AI-supported software development practices, tools, and workflows in the specialist area
  • Supervision of students and external development service providers with focus on technical quality, regulatory expectations, and team learning
  • Assessment of the impact of changes to standards, technologies, and AI-supported development methods on the specialist area
  • Independent mentoring of new employees and engineers in software development practices
  • Participation in the hiring process for new employees, with focus on technical leadership capability and readiness for AI-supported software development
  • Support in the performance evaluation of employees by providing technical input on software engineering skills, collaboration, and development practices
  • Participation, where appropriate, in specialist conferences and external committees to monitor trends in medical-device software development and AI-supported engineering
  • Advising management on business and technology decisions related to software development leadership and AI-supported software engineering

Requirements

Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies

  • Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics, systems engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
  • Approximately 2 years' experience in leading software development for regulated medical devices and guiding engineers in the implementation of software solutions
  • Strong understanding of AI-supported software development approaches and practices, with the ability to lead their adoption within a development team
  • Very good knowledge of system development, software architecture, and software design
  • Extensive knowledge of embedded software development in C/C++ sufficient to provide technical direction, review solutions, and guide implementation decisions
  • Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring engineers, and ensuring high-quality implementation in software projects
  • Confident use of software development tools, AI-supported engineering approaches, and Microsoft Office
  • Good verbal and written English skills (CEFR B2)*
  • Desirable: knowledge in the areas of electrical engineering and transmission protocols
  • Strong leadership mindset with the ability to guide engineers, set technical direction, and create alignment in software development activities
  • High willingness and capability to drive change, especially the transformation from classical software development to AI-supported software development
  • Quality-conscious, trustworthy, and reliable
  • Team-oriented, communicative, and able to influence without relying on direct disciplinary authority
  • Structured and systematic working style with the ability to translate strategic goals into practical team practices

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to all sites and business contacts, up to a maximum of 10% travel

title: Working Student, Growth & Strategy (m/f/d)
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Working Student supports the GTM Strategy & Transformation function, working directly with the Senior Director on high-impact strategic and operational priorities. The role contributes to market research, competitive analysis, process improvement, and growth initiatives that directly support the revenue organisation's go-to-market execution. This is a hands-on, project-based role suited to a student with strong analytical foundations, an interest in commercial strategy, and the initiative to take ownership of outcomes rather than just tasks.

Main Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end delivery of high-priority GTM initiatives: tracking milestones, managing stakeholder inputs, and ensuring projects deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in go-to-market processes, proposing and helping implement frameworks that improve scalability across the organisation.

  • Translate data and analysis into structured, concise storylines and presentations for senior stakeholders.

  • Conduct market research and competitive benchmarking, synthesising findings into clear briefings and recommendations that support executive-level decision-making.

  • Work closely with the Senior Director, GTM Strategy & Transformation and cross-functional teams to support evolving strategic priorities as they arise.



Required Experience

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced environment, such as a startup, venture-backed company, or management consultancy, is a strong advantage.

Required Skills

  • Analytical and structured: goes beyond surface-level data, questions assumptions, and draws independent, well-reasoned conclusions.

  • Takes initiative and ownership: identifies problems, proposes solutions, and follows through to implementation without waiting to be directed.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where projects don't have an established playbook.

  • Able to structure complex ideas in writing and produce concise, high-quality output for senior audiences.

  • Collaborative and adaptable: works effectively across functions and adjusts quickly to shifting priorities.

  • Fluent in English.

Please note: This is a working student position, limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week during the semester. Applicants must be currently enrolled at a university and provide valid proof of enrollment (“Immatrikulationsbescheinigung” in Germany). Compensation is hourly €18.

description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Senior Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program.

You will play a central role in designing, testing and scaling up a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating.

You will be part of the team bridging manufacturing technology for first prototypes to full scale manufacturing

You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define the requirements for industrialised manufacturing equipment and processes, to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation

  • Contribute to the development of in process monitoring and non destructive testing

  • Help to determine and justify quality requirements to ensure smooth manufacturing while keeping the required product performance

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams

  • Hands on experience in prototyping and testing

  • Proficient in creating development plans from start to finish for a new process

  • Experience in trouble-shooting issues as they arise on production lines

  • Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment

  • Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

  • Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with engineers and technical staff

  • A high performer who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity in both prototype manufacturing and industrial manufacturing

  • Comfortable with CAD: good knowledge of Catia V5 or 3DExperience are considered as a plus

  • A background in product testing and qualification in a regulated industry is a plus

  • Exposure to SCADA systems or MES integration

We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.

As arguably SpaceX's most complex software engineering challenge, Starlink offers a variety of areas within software engineering that you can focus. As a Software Engineer on the Starlink program, you will be solving challenges underpinning every aspect of the program’s growth. The teams and areas you could have an impact on could include, but are not limited to:

  • Physic based software engineering to design and simulate the orbital life cycle of the Starlink constellation.

We expect our engineers to close the feedback loop between software design and real-world performance. In this role, your software will have a meaningful and measurable impact on the world.

  • Demonstrated rapid growth. You’ve held successive positions of increasing responsibility within an organization, were able to get yourself up to speed at a heroic pace, and accomplished something meaningfully difficult early in your career.

The team is hiring engineers from pre-silicon through post-silicon across many disciplines in RF/Analog IC, RTL design, design verification, physical design, DFT, validation and more using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on self-starter who can execute the steps required to fully design and verify complex designs.

Full-time employment is available working on our Starlink program in Palo Alto (CA), Irvine (CA), or Redmond (WA).

    • Derive specifications for the RFIC subsystems and circuits

  • Physical Design
    • Perform synthesis and physical implementation steps (synthesis, floor planning, place and route, timing/noise analysis, physical verification, electromigration, voltage drop, logic equivalency and other signoff checks)
    • Develop/improve physical design methodologies and automation scripts for various implementation steps

Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations.
